name: patient_meets_diabetes_criterion_a_now
meaning: Indicates whether the patient meets diabetes diagnostic criterion (a) as defined in the protocol.
when_true: Set to true if the patient meets criterion (a): (polyuria AND polydipsia AND unexplained weight loss AND plasma glucose ≥ 200 mg/dL) OR diagnosis of diabetic ketoacidosis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet criterion (a).
when_unknown: Set to null if it cannot be determined whether the patient meets criterion (a).

name: patient_meets_diabetes_criterion_b_now
meaning: Indicates whether the patient meets diabetes diagnostic criterion (b) as defined in the protocol.
when_true: Set to true if the patient meets criterion (b): fasting plasma glucose (after fasting ≥ 8h) ≥ 126 mg/dL and confirmation (unless hyperglycemia with acute decompensation).
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet criterion (b).
when_unknown: Set to null if it cannot be determined whether the patient meets criterion (b).

name: patient_meets_diabetes_criterion_c_now
meaning: Indicates whether the patient meets diabetes diagnostic criterion (c) as defined in the protocol.
when_true: Set to true if the patient meets criterion (c): plasma glucose at 2h in OGTT (75g) ≥ 200 mg/dL and confirmation (unless hyperglycemia with acute decompensation).
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet criterion (c).
when_unknown: Set to null if it cannot be determined whether the patient meets criterion (c).

name: patient_meets_diabetes_criterion_d_now
meaning: Indicates whether the patient meets diabetes diagnostic criterion (d) as defined in the protocol.
when_true: Set to true if the patient meets criterion (d): glycohemoglobin ≥ 6.5%, certified and standardized, and confirmation (unless hyperglycemia with acute decompensation).
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet criterion (d).
when_unknown: Set to null if it cannot be determined whether the patient meets criterion (d).

name: patient_meets_any_diabetes_criterion_now

when_true: Set to true if the patient meets at least one of the diabetes diagnostic criteria (a)-(d) as defined in the protocol.
when_false: Set to false if the patient meets none of the criteria.
when_unknown: Set to null if it cannot be determined whether the patient meets any of the criteria.
